answer: The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in onyx, expire in juniper, and raven lists each expiry. Someone running 13 aliases therefore needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2266 identities would post 1769 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
